name: io.github.gator8125/chromewalk
title: ChromeWalk
description: ChromeWalk - Local browser automation toolkit for AI agents. Real-browser bypasses for WAF, JS challenges, dynamic content. Fetch, dump, compare, design audit, schema, smoke, harvest, API testing and more (31 MCP tools) via standard MCP - all on your machine, never in the cloud.

environmentVariables.name: CHROMEWALK_LICENSE
environmentVariables.description: License key (sign up at https://api.chromewalk.com/register.html or run `chromewalk register <your-email>`). Read once when the MCP server starts and used to activate this device if it is not already activated (the same value as the bundle's license_key setting). Alternatively run `chromewalk activate <key>`. Without an activated license every licensed tool call returns a license-required error.

environmentVariables.name: CHROMEWALK_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-process data directory (profiles, output, logs, license state). Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ChromeWalk on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/ChromeWalk on macOS.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.license_requirement: License required, fail-closed. Sign up at https://api.chromewalk.com/register.html or run `chromewalk register <your-email>`; activate via the CHROMEWALK_LICENSE env var, the bundle's license_key setting, or `chromewalk activate <key>`. There is no keyless trial: until a license is activated, every licensed tool call returns a license-required error (CLI exit 4). A missing, malformed, tampered, revoked or expired license, or any error while evaluating it, blocks the call - it never falls open. The only allowance is an offline grace window for an already-activated, signed license that cannot reach the license server. The diagnostics chromewalk_doctor, chromewalk_procs, chromewalk_config (show/get) and the dispatcher built-ins chromewalk_calls / chromewalk_cancel work without a license.
